frontend_status: Provisional existing Collect origins. Reconcile site_url, invitation/recovery links and application callback with the qualified Cloudflare frontend hosting and Supabase transport handoff before any provider update or email send.

invite.contract: Open the Admin login page and request a fresh code for the approved staff email. No password setup is required.

magic_link.contract: Render the managed six-digit Token for code entry; do not substitute a magic-link session handoff.

recovery.contract: Optional existing password recovery exchanges TokenHash through the Admin server; no managed access or refresh token enters the URL.

confirmation.contract: Render the managed six-digit Token for initial email confirmation and code entry. Do not include a confirmation-link or session-token URL handoff.

email_delivery.required_configuration: Existing authorized custom SMTP or Supabase Send Email Hook. The default project mailer does not satisfy production staff/member delivery.

google.client_configuration_status: Created with the exact Supabase callback. The initial secret was captured in a copy-control label during inspection and must be replaced before use. It has not been configured in Supabase or activated.
google.application_callback_status: Provisional until the Cloudflare same-origin frontend transport to Supabase is qualified by the migration and release owners.
google.redirect_allowlist_status: Prepared only. The query delimiter has one literal glob-escape backslash after JSON decoding. Reconcile the qualified frontend host and verify actual managed matching before applying uri_allow_list.
google.redirect_allowlist_security_note: Supabase Auth also admits redirects sharing SITE_URL authority. The allowlist does not replace fixed server callback, state, PKCE, surface and exact opener-origin checks. The collect:// URI is the final app handoff, not managed redirect_to.
google.activation_contract: Configure and enable the managed provider only in the coordinated qualification phase. Keep published client Google flags off until approved member/Admin callback, PKCE, role, cookie and MFA checks pass; then release the client flags separately.

application_constraints.admin_session: HttpOnly cookie with current staff role and managed MFA
application_constraints.unknown_delivery: Keep the current challenge and code entry, show the uncertainty, and require an explicit resend after the server cooldown.
application_constraints.public_signup_policy: Managed signups and application member registration are paused for the first import. The migration owner must preserve original identities and explicitly coordinate re-enablement after import qualification.
